tests.name: Enable Guest account with RDP capability and admin privileges
tests.description:
After execution the Default Guest account will be enabled (Active) and added to Administrators and Remote Desktop Users Group,
and desktop will allow multiple RDP connections.

tests.description: The Adversaries can activate the default Guest user. The guest account is inactivated by default
